name: PHPC Stablecoin
collateral: Philippine peso cash, time deposits, and short-term money market instruments held in custodial banking institutions selected by Coins.ph; reserves maintained at 100% of circulating PHPC during the BSP regulatory sandbox
pegMechanism: 1:1 fiat-collateralized: Coins.ph users mint PHPC by depositing PHP and redeem PHPC for PHP through the Coins.ph platform; at the end of the BSP sandbox period any remaining PHPC is reimbursed 100% by the issuer

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Possible retained: BSP-licensed VASP issuer with centralized governance; contract source not independently reviewed for admin freeze, blacklist, pause, or upgrade authority.

reserves.name: PHP cash, time deposits, and short-term money market instruments at custodial banks

notices.title: BSP regulatory sandbox
notices.message: PHPC is issued under the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Regulatory Sandbox Framework. Coins.ph also deploys PHPC on Ronin Network, which is not yet tracked by Pharos; Polygon supply is the canonical observable surface.
